defects.title: P1 makes --unattended accepted by gated commands before their gate conversion lands
defects.quote: the `--unattended` flag accepted by every command in sections 3.1 and 3.2 (a no-op where a command has no gate)
defects.what_goes_wrong: After P1 (declared independently useful, line 154) about 22 gated commands (e.g. auggie-review, cleanup, task, cli-eval, implement, post-release, pr-submit) accept --unattended and carry an Unattended section (AC-1.1) while their prompts and outward defaults stay live until P2-P4, so a coordinator briefed per section 2.3 to pass --unattended gets silent stalls and outward actions (auggie-review posting) that WC-2/WC-9 say cannot happen; AC-1.2 live-checks only P1 commands so nothing catches it, and AC-1.1 also forces sections for implement/post-release/pr-submit whose rules wait on D2-D4 (D3(a) says no pr-submit changes).
defects.is_fixed_when: No phase leaves a command in a state where it accepts --unattended while any of its WC-2 gates or WC-9 outward defaults is unconverted: either each command gains the flag/section (and AC-1.1 assertion) only in the phase that converts all its gates, or every not-yet-converted command refuses --unattended (fail closed, e.g. status: blocked) until then, and section 2.3 tells the coordinator to pass the flag only to commands whose phase has landed; commands gated on D2-D4 get no section before the decision.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting the flag or the gated commands from scope would remove the contract's purpose; deleting only the P1 universal-acceptance clause counts only if replaced by per-phase acceptance or a refusal rule.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 2.3 (line 73) brief rule, AC-1.1 (line 195) and AC-1.2 (line 196), P0 brief template (line 158), section 3 intro (line 76), section 6 P2-P4 rows, D3 (line 240) and section 4 note on pr-submit (line 139).

defects.title: index row neither refuses nor pins knowledge-base mode, contradicting UNVERIFIED item 6
defects.quote: state that knowledge-base mode does not wait (whether it does is UNVERIFIED)
defects.what_goes_wrong: Item 6 (line 277) says section 3 refuses or pins index's knowledge-base mode under --unattended regardless, but the index row (line 111) only asserts in prose that the mode does not wait, so an implementer adds a sentence instead of a guard and, if the mode does wait, the P1 worker silently stalls.
defects.is_fixed_when: The index row and UNVERIFIED item 6 agree: either the row refuses or pins knowledge-base mode under --unattended (like business-panel and explain), or item 6 drops index and the spec states how the no-wait claim is verified before P1.
defects.deletion_note: Partly: deleting index from item 6's 'refuses or pins regardless' claim removes the contradiction only if the row then says how the unverified no-wait claim is checked; deleting the index command row is not a fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: UNVERIFIED item 6 (line 277); P1 scope list (line 159); AC-1.2 live check.

defects.title: 7.2 step 5 transcript text search for AskUserQuestion hits mentions, not calls
defects.quote: search the transcript for `AskUserQuestion`. **Pass:** no `AskUserQuestion` call.
defects.what_goes_wrong: The check method is a plain string search of the transcript, which also matches the worker reading WORKER-CONTRACT.md (WC-2 quotes AskUserQuestion) or skill files that mention it, so the method does not define how a call is distinguished from a mention and a literal grep fails conforming workers.
defects.is_fixed_when: Step 5 restricts the search to tool-call entries whose tool name is AskUserQuestion (or an equivalent structured filter) rather than any occurrence of the string in the transcript.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting step 5 removes the only direct WC-2 evidence; step 2's agentWait check does not catch a prompt that was answered or timed out.
defects.present_in_others_hint: AC-0.4 (line 194) which verifies 'no Agent-tool wrapper' through the same step-5 transcript; AC-3.2 'no [Y/n] in the transcript' (line 205) has the same text-search weakness.

defects.title: cli-portify resolves every approval gate as blocked, so AC-2.3 happy path cannot pass
defects.quote: each of the three approval gates resolves as blocked with the artifact to review named in the contract
defects.what_goes_wrong: The three always-on approval gates (INV-A:45) only resolve as blocked and no flag carries an approval (resume restarts at the same gate), so an unattended cli-portify can never end succeeded, while AC-2.3 requires a succeeded happy-path run for every P2 command including cli-portify, so P2 cannot pass.
defects.is_fixed_when: Either the cli-portify row names a caller-supplied approval input (WC-2 resolution b) that lets an unattended run pass all three gates, or AC-2.3 explicitly exempts cli-portify and states its expected unattended outcome (blocked/failed at the first gate).
defects.deletion_note: No: removing cli-portify from scope without stating it is human-in-the-loop only hides the gap; an explicit AC-2.3 exemption with stated expected outcome is acceptable.
defects.present_in_others_hint: AC-2.3 (line 201), P2 command list (line 160), WC-3 re-invoke-with-answer-as-flag route (line 61).

defects.title: Ready-today tdd and troubleshoot can still prompt with the stated brief flags
defects.quote: These run as workers now if the brief uses the stated flags
defects.what_goes_wrong: The tdd row's brief flags do not stop the nested /task 'ask the user' when several task files match (sk/task/SKILL.md:49 via INV-B:219), and the troubleshoot brief only forbids --fix so --depth deep with a short input still hits the STOP that asks the user (INV-B:239); both gates are unconverted until P2, so a 'ready' worker can stall silently.
defects.is_fixed_when: Section 3.1 either lists brief constraints that avoid these triggers (e.g. troubleshoot: no --depth deep or input of at least 10 words; tdd: an input that cannot hit the nested /task multi-match prompt) or moves tdd and troubleshoot out of ready-today until their P2 conversion.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting the rows removes two ready commands (troubleshoot is a P0 smoke target); moving them to section 3.2 with P2 is a fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: P0 smoke runs and AC-0.4 (lines 158, 194) use troubleshoot; reflect and release-split rows in 3.1 carry similar P2-deferred gates.
